replication.target_description: SCORE replication of the self-esteem difference between moderate ADM and moderate ADM+RIV classes (H*). The prerequisite class identification failed, so the focal self-esteem regression was not conducted. Reported chi-square tests concern class recovery and are not the focal test.

n.sample_role: No analytic sample for the unperformed focal self-esteem test established. The prerequisite latent-class analyses used a final eligible participant pool of 1255, with random draws of 1000 participants.
n.exclusions: Qualtrics screened attention-check failures; five additional cases removed for missing data from 1260 quality completes, yielding 1255 for prerequisite analyses; these are not an established focal-test n.

notes: Input study identifiers, outcome description, and locators were empty.
